newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea carmakers to urge govt intervention in Kia.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea carmakers to urge govt intervention in Kia.

text.p: Heads of South Korean carmakers will meet at noon (0300 GMT) on Tuesday and urge the government to intervene to resolve the Kia problems, a spokesman at the Korea Automobile Manufacturers' Association said.
"They are expected to discuss the current problems of Kia and its impact on subcontractors, which are on the brink of defaults," the spokesmsan said.
"After the meeting, they will urge the government to intervene to solve Kia's troubles," he added.
Kia Motors Corp is the flagship of the troubled Kia Group.
